In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between R +26.4 and R +13.7. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.

D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Seth Bodnar runs furthest behind in Fergus, Sanders, Madison. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: White voters, 93% of voters, 28 to 20, where a 5 point gain is worth 4.63 points; Voters who cast ballots in 2022 and 2024, 72% of voters, 28 to 20, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.58 points; Midsize counties, 61% of voters, 32 to 23, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.06 points.

The forecast's worst groups for Seth Bodnar: Immigration voters 9 to 7, Voters who can afford daily costs 23 to 17, Small counties 23 to 17. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
$999K cash against $1.5M. Outspent: lean on earned media, digital, field and the outside groups, and pick the two or three media markets that decide it.
